# readme-badges — apply

## Values

```powershell
$pkg = (Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).name
$repo = gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner
Write-Host "NPM=$pkg REPO=$repo"
```

## Insert or replace

1. Open `README.md`.
2. Ensure H1 is the product title.
3. Insert/replace the standard centered badge block (see `SKILL.md`) with `$pkg` and `$repo`.
4. Search README for other npm/GitHub URLs; align install links.

## Verify

```powershell
Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern "template-npm-shared-library|npm-winccoa-template|ui-pnl-xml" || echo "no obvious leftovers"
npm run lint:md
# or
npm run style-fix
```
